prompt:
Author a production sprite animation source of the EXACT MALE REAPER shown in both references, not a new design. A PORTRAIT transparent RGBA atlas, EXACTLY ONE COLUMN and EIGHT ROWS: 8 separate full-body EAST-facing WALK phases arranged TOP to BOTTOM, one complete articulated character with entire scythe per row. All 8 strictly face screen RIGHT in the same side camera, NOT 8 different directions. Same black enclosed pointed helmet, tall attached teal crest, black armor with the same sharp gold ornament, teal-black torn cloak, gold armored boots and huge cyan crescent scythe from the reference. Preserve the original hand-painted 2D RPG sprite look, body proportions, gear and identity. Both hands carry the same single scythe approximately horizontal at waist/chest, dark-gold shaft extends left and the complete crescent blade lies to the RIGHT, blade tip and end of shaft both inside every cell. Hand grip remains attached and consistent in all phases. No attack gesture.
Eight distinct WALK phases in chronological order, NOT copied stills, no scaling or bobbing substitutes. The viewer-NEAR leg is the clearly foreground leg; retain its identity through all phases without swapping near/far labels:
ROW1 CONTACT-A: near gold boot leads RIGHT, heel touching ground, far leg extended back LEFT on toe.
ROW2 DOWN-A: weight loads onto the near leading leg, that knee visibly bends; far heel lifts with far toe just leaving the ground behind LEFT.
ROW3 PASS-A: near leg planted almost under pelvis; far thigh/knee flex and pass FORWARD beneath the pelvis, far boot raised clear of ground. Two whole connected leg chains visible.
ROW4 UP-A: near support leg extends behind LEFT, heel raised; far knee/boot advances RIGHT and forward heel is still just above ground.
ROW5 CONTACT-B: truly reversed legs: FAR boot now leads RIGHT on heel, NEAR leg trails LEFT on toe. Keep correct foreground occlusion, do not paste the same row1 leg arrangement.
ROW6 DOWN-B: weight loads onto far leading leg, its knee visibly bends; near heel lifts and near toe leaves the ground behind LEFT.
ROW7 PASS-B: far leg supports under pelvis; near knee flexes and passes forward, NEAR boot raised clear of ground.
ROW8 UP-B: far support trails LEFT on toe; near knee/boot advances RIGHT, heel approaching contact for loop back to row1.
Keep hips, thighs, knees, shins, ankles and both boots fully attached throughout; cape remains BEHIND the leg chains and does not make legs disappear. Pelvis and helmet scale stable, only a subtle real weight shift. Scythe carry has modest continuous inertia, not attacks or changing weapon. Same pelvis horizontal centre and ground-line within each equal-height row. Each whole figure including crest and entire long scythe occupies at most 70% of its row height, with broad transparent gutters above/below and both sides, so none touches another row. No detached glow particles, mist, aura, ground/shadow, labels, grid or background. Closely attached cyan blade/crest highlights only. Eight bodies total, one per row, generous margins. Portrait canvas 1024x1536.
